text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
The folks who came to cheer were so happy, too...
I'm on absolute cloud nine right now!
choice_data_list: Everyone was caught up in the excitement, huh.
Everyone was caught up in the excitement, wasn't it?
Let's keep doing our best with training.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
Everyone in the stands, and everyone back home too...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Dad was just on the phone earlier,
saying they were all about to raise a celebratory toast!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Whoops, you're right!
Can't let the results go to our heads!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of everyone who supports me,
I can't afford to look uncool.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I have to work harder and harder so I can keep bringing smiles to everyone!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Kitasan Black
is gonna keep getting stronger and stronger!
